## Summary
The request was to identify phishing websites from address, page, and domain features so a browser can warn users. Several model approaches were tried, and the platform selected and verified a bagged-tree model. Its test ROC AUC was 0.9936.

**Observations**
- Test accuracy was 0.9590 and test recall was 0.9653.
- Test PR AUC was 0.9949.
- Validation mean ROC AUC was 0.9937.

**Limitations**
- Leakage was not screened, so these results do not establish that the features or learned processing are free of leakage.
- Performance may differ when deployed on websites with different characteristics or a different phishing prevalence.
- The metrics do not determine whether the model’s warning threshold offers an acceptable tradeoff between missed phishing sites and false alarms.
